svg.title: Three triple pendulums started a billionth of a radian apart
svg.desc: Three identical triple pendulums move as one for about 10 seconds, then follow completely different paths, while their rods and energy stay exactly the same.
svg.text: how far the tip can reach: always known

g.text: Same rods, same physics, a billionth of a radian apart
For now the three move as one.
After 10 seconds they have nothing in common
Rods intact, energy unchanged. Only the future is gone.
